verdict.rationale: Pylon documents AI grounded in the customer's own content: Support Agents deflect questions using content, training data can be connected to power its AI features, and the knowledge base is "supercharged with AI." Nothing in the pack shows answers citing or linking the article or source they drew from, and nothing says every answer is restricted to the user's content. missing for 10: evidence that answers display source/article citations, evidence that answers are constrained to the user's own content, independent or hands-on corroboration of grounding quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every answer is grounded in my own content and shows which article or source it drew from

citations.quote: Support Agents can deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context for your team, and take action.
Supercharge all of Pylon's AI features by connecting training data for the AI to consume.
A dedicated place to host your support content, including question-and-answer style articles, internal runbooks, and more -- all supercharged with AI and tightly integrated with the Pylon platform.
Ask AI is a general purpose AI chat that can help you and your team answers all the questions you might have about your existing data.
